routes.board: CMS danfo park, under the bridge by Tafawa Balewa Square, Marina
routes.notes: Frequent danfo from CMS park. Heavy traffic 7-9am and 4-7pm.

routes.board: Oshodi BRT terminal, Bolade axis of Agege Motor Road
routes.notes: BRT lane available; smoother than danfo in rush hour.

routes.board: CMS danfo park, under the bridge by Tafawa Balewa Square, Marina
routes.notes: Take danfo/BRT CMS->Oshodi, then BRT Oshodi->Ikeja. Change at Oshodi terminal.
Danfo from Obalende under-bridge park. Ask for Lekki first gate.

routes.board: Yaba bus stop on Herbert Macaulay Way, by the Oyingbo market end
routes.notes: Board at Yaba bus stop heading toward Ojuelegba then Oshodi.

routes.board: Mile 2 danfo park on the Badagry Expressway service road
routes.notes: Apapa-Oshodi expressway can be slow due to trucks.

routes.board: Ikorodu BRT terminal by the Ikorodu roundabout (also serves Agric)
routes.notes: Ikorodu BRT corridor is the fastest option into Lagos Island.

routes.board: Berger bus stop on the Lagos-Ibadan Expressway service lane
routes.notes: Along the Lagos-Ibadan expressway service lane.

routes.board: Ajah junction danfo park, by the flyover on the Lekki-Epe Expressway
